title: [GMCP 203.029.M] Mastery: Local process, filesystem, and network sandboxing
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-029-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Each local MCP server executes under a declared sandbox profile with minimal filesystem, network, process, device, environment and resource access, implemented on Linux, macOS and Windows with visible degradation when an OS primitive is unavailable. Profiles are generated from permissions, independently enforced outside the child, immutable after launch, and defeated by none of the traversal, symlink, namespace, child-process or localhost escape tests. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
